terms.meaning: code that runs on the server, not in the visitor's browser
the folders and files stored on a computer or server

used_by: The persona route, inferred from the folder name.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Server imports for the persona page
sections.what: Brings in the file reading tools, the shared header and footer, and the browser viewer.
sections.why: Reading files needs server-side code, so this page runs on the server.
sections.watch_out: If the host does not include the persona files, the page shows nothing.

sections.name: PersonaPage
sections.title: Server side persona file listing
sections.what: Reads the list of markdown files in the persona folder and the resume files in its resumes subfolder on the server. It then lists six expected core files with descriptions and passes both lists to the browser view.
sections.why: Keeps file access on the server, where the folder lives.
sections.watch_out: A missing folder counts as empty and read errors are only written to the server log, so a broken folder shows PENDING with no visible error.

summary: Server-side persona page that reads files from disk and passes them to the browser viewer. Only its imports were visible.
purpose: Likely shows the user's persona documents.
why: Likely reason: reading files from disk needs server code, so this page runs on the server.
how: Only the imports are visible. They bring in the file system and path tools, the shared header and footer, and the browser viewer. The rest is not visible.
inputs: Files in the app's persona folder (inferred).
outputs: A page showing the persona viewer.
risks: The page depends on the files existing where the server looks. Hosting differences can hide them.
debug: If the page is empty, check the persona folder path and confirm the files exist on the host.
